reasoning_traces.think:
The core tension lies in distinguishing between a genuine edge and a spurious market echo. The 58.5% MLB totals beat-close figure must be re-evaluated in price space per Bickel–Kim, since current point-line-only computation ignores real juice. If the signal flips under corrected pricing, then the platform’s sole live indicator is invalidated. This necessitates immediate diagnostic work to assess whether the model pipeline collapses signal into a flat number, or preserves variation. An independent model conditioned on game-specific covariates (park, weather, pitcher rest) is required to generate resolution rather than merely measure it. Resolution is not created by post-hoc adjustments but by injecting new conditioning information. The grouping-loss lower bound serves as a go/no-go gate to ensure that engineering effort is not wasted on models that fail to differentiate subpopulations. The failure mode occurs when the model's resolution approaches zero, indicating that all forecasts collapse to a single value regardless of input features.
